# `company.inventory_assignments`

Numbering of tracked units after the fact: units at one place moved between unassigned and lots or serial numbers. Posts nothing.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable assignment. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_assignments_item | items.id | Tracked item whose units are numbered. |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Site the units are at. |
| `bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin the units are in; null for no bin. |
| `date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_assignments_item | — | Date the numbering applies from, YYYY-MM-DD (a document line's own date). |
| `count_position` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | before or after the counts of its site on its date. |
| `direction` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | assign (unassigned units take numbers) or unassign (numbered units become unassigned). |
| `movement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_inventory_assignments_movement | inventory_movements.id | Movement whose units this numbers (which unit a sale took); null for units on hand. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo as entered; null when blank. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why the units were numbered, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this assignment was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this assignment. |

| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this assignment. |
